title: Validation of binding affinities and stabilities of ivermectin and moxidectin against Sars-CoV-2 receptors
author: Emmanuel Chuks Oranu
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Download NSP13 crystal structure
steps.instruction: Retrieve the experimental crystal structure of the SARS‑CoV‑2 NSP13 receptor from the Protein Data Bank (PDB).

steps.title: Prepare receptor structure
steps.instruction: Process the downloaded NSP13 structure using Chimera 1.10.1 and AutoDock Tools 1.5.6 to generate a docking‑ready PDBQT file.

steps.title: Obtain and prepare ligand structures
steps.instruction: Download the 3‑D structures of Ivermectin, Moxidectin, Molnupiravir, and the reference ligand from PDB and DrugBank, then prepare each with AutoDock Tools 1.5.6 for docking.

steps.title: Validate docking protocol
steps.instruction: Reproduce the PDB crystal structures in silico (redocking) to confirm that the docking workflow reproduces known binding modes.

steps.title: Run docking simulations
steps.instruction: Perform molecular docking of the prepared ligands against the NSP13 receptor using AutoDock Vina 4.2.6 on Ubuntu 20.04 (Linux).

steps.title: Analyze docking results
steps.instruction: Analyze and visualize the docking output with PyMOL 2.3.0 to assess binding affinities and poses.

steps.title: Conduct molecular dynamics
steps.instruction: Run molecular dynamics simulations of the top‑scoring ligand‑protein complexes (frontrunners) together with the reference ligand for a total of 10 000 ps.

description: Validation of docking protocol was done by reproducing the PDB crystal structures insilico . Molecular docking simulations were performed using AutoDockVina-4.2.6 on the Linux operating system (ubuntu) 20.
